$comment: FIXTURE: only individual (deeply nested) *properties* of this module are referenced, never a $def and never the module as a whole -> the referenced property subtrees (and what they reach) must be kept under their original JSON-pointer path, the siblings and the top-level body must be dropped. The top-level title/description live in the dropped body and must not appear in the bundle.
title: Used properties only
description: A module of which only nested properties are referenced.

address.$comment: Reached only through its nested children, never as a whole -> the container stays hollow, only the referenced children survive.
address.title: Address

city.$comment: Not referenced -> dropped although its siblings are kept.
city.title: City

geo.$comment: Reached from main via a three-level deep pointer into #/properties/address/properties/geo/properties/lat.
geo.title: Geo

lat.$comment: Deeply nested leaf that is referenced directly from main. Has an internal ref -> transitively keeps $defs/degrees.
lat.title: Latitude

lon.$comment: Deeply nested leaf that is NOT referenced -> dropped.
lon.title: Longitude

contact.$comment: Referenced from main as a whole property (with all its children) -> kept entirely, including the unreferenced phone.
contact.title: Contact

phone.$comment: Not referenced individually, but kept because the parent property 'contact' is referenced as a whole.
phone.title: Phone

unusedTopLevel.$comment: Not referenced -> dropped together with everything it refers to; must NOT make unused.schema.json reachable.
unusedTopLevel.title: Unused top level

unusedDef.title: Unused def
unusedDef.description: A definition nothing reachable refers to.
